name: propose_slots
description: Read the founder's Google Calendar free-busy and return 3 candidate 25-minute slots within the next 7 business days. Used by draft_outreach to make intro/screening emails concrete instead of '…happy to chat sometime'. Degrades to a deterministic fallback (next 3 weekday mornings) if the gcal connector isn't wired or the call fails, so outreach drafts always succeed.
